purpose: Stage 20A full public-build asset rights audit; zero preapproved public media
notes: Release-safe media (including image, logo, icon, font, social preview and other distributable assets) must have one exact dist path, SHA-256, provenance, rights owner, restricted evidence pointer, independent named human reviewer, review date and permitted use. No review-only concept, supplier diagram or synthetic photograph is approved here. Remote/data assets must be replaced with pinned local files. Generated HTML/CSS/JS also receive per-byte digests in the report but require separate build-wide #71 human sign-off. Production GO cannot be issued by this registry.
